mapper.sql: SELECT i.*, c.name AS category_name FROM service_beauty_item i LEFT JOIN service_category c ON c.id = i.category_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO service_beauty_item(name, category_id, retail_price_cent, discount_type, discount_rate, show_cashier, show_shop, earn_points, sort_no, is_active) VALUES (#{name}, #{categoryId}, #{retailPriceCent}, #{discountType}, #{discountRate}, #{showCashier}, #{showShop}, #{earnPoints}, #{sortNo}, #{isActive})
